question.text: Scenario: Capital Edge Research Pvt Ltd is a newly registered research entity planning to set up operations. The founder, Nikhil Shah, is designing the firm's compliance framework. He needs to address: (1) How to structure analyst compensation without creating IB conflicts. (2) What disclosures to include in every research report. (3) How to handle situations where the firm also provides IB advisory services. (4) What trading restrictions to impose on analysts and their associates. (5) How to maintain a website as per SEBI requirements. The firm plans to cover 50 companies across 5 sectors, employ 8 full-time analysts and 3 part-time analysts, and offer both subscription-based research and fee-based advisory services to accredited investors. Question 3 of 5: If Capital Edge also provides IB advisory, the research team must be:

answer.text: On the same team as IB for collaboration

Separated by appropriate mechanisms for independence and arms-length relationships, with no IB/merchant banking/brokerage representation in compensation review, no supervision/control of analysts by those divisions, and no IB-directed research sales, marketing, or client communications
Only separated by a written policy with no further independence mechanisms
Free to share all research with IB before publication

explanation.text: The Logic: Research must be conducted under appropriate independence mechanisms with an arms-length relationship to the IB/merchant banking/brokerage activity. IB, merchant banking, and brokerage divisions cannot be represented in the compensation review of analysts and cannot supervise or control the analysts. Research sales, marketing, and client communications cannot be directed by these divisions. The Trap: A written policy alone is insufficient if analysts are still supervised, controlled by, or directed for sales/marketing/client communications by the IB/merchant banking/brokerage divisions. Note: Source supports independence mechanisms and arms-length separation; specific physical or digital information-barrier language is not stated in the checked pages.
